purpose: Variables injected per-page so every spoke is hyper-contextualised and Google reads it as unique (not thin/duplicate). Each page resolves {genre} x {city} x {service} into a unique combination of the fields below.
antiDuplicateRule: A page is unique when >=4 of these axes differ from any sibling: localScene, chartReference, slangLexicon, technicalSpec, hardwareRef, distributionFormat, bpmRange, scaleOrKey. Title/H1/meta rotated via deterministic hash of (slug) so no two share a pattern.
